design_concept: Neo-Brutalist Utility / The 'Green Room' Terminal. A high-contrast, zero-distraction interface that feels like a professional toolkit. Uses stark typography and hard borders to prioritize speed and readability under any lighting condition.

rules: Banned: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-neutral-600

layout.strategy: Mobile-first, single-column stack. No complex grids needed for a single-screen form. Focus on massive inputs and readable outputs.

surface_styles.form_inputs: bg-white border-2 border-[#0D0D0D] rounded-none p-4 focus:outline-none focus:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#E63946] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0D0D0D] transition-shadow duration-200 text-lg md:text-xl font-bold placeholder:text-neutral-400 placeholder:font-normal w-full
surface_styles.primary_button: w-full bg-[#E63946] text-white border-2 border-[#0D0D0D] uppercase font-black tracking-widest text-xl py-6 hover:bg-[#D62828] active:translate-y-[2px] active:translate-x-[2px] transition-all shadow-[6px_6px_0px_#0D0D0D] hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0D0D0D] active:shadow-[0px_0px_0px_#0D0D0D]
surface_styles.output_card: bg-[#0D0D0D] text-[#F4F4F0] border-2 border-[#0D0D0D] rounded-none p-6 sm:p-8 mt-12 shadow-[8px_8px_0px_#E63946]

select.description: Custom massive dropdown for 'Event Type'. Should feel like picking a mode on a machine. High contrast.
select.style: Uses form_inputs base style. Must have a stark, chunky dropdown arrow icon.

input.description: Room size input. Large text, numeric keyboard on mobile.

textarea.description: Audience context. Auto-resizing or fixed height (e.g., 3 lines).

output_sections.room_energy: Text block with an energetic icon. Yellow accent text (#FFD166).
output_sections.opening_move: Large, bold font to make the actual script stand out.
output_sections.anchor_move: Boxed out inside the dark card. border-2 border-[#F4F4F0] p-4
output_sections.avoid: Red text color inside the dark theme. text-[#E63946] font-bold

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Hard brutalist transitions. Shadows shrink and elements translate down-right to simulate physical pressing.
interactions_and_motion.focus_states: Inputs gain a colored shadow (Signal Red) or thicker border.
interactions_and_motion.loading_state: Replace button text with 'READING THE ROOM...' and a fast, blocky ASCII or CSS loading bar. No soft spinners.
interactions_and_motion.output_entrance: Framer motion: `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: 'easeOut' }}`

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Exceeds APCA requirements. Pure black on off-white, white on pure black.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements and form fields MUST have `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid="event-type-select"`, `data-testid="generate-strategy-btn"`, `data-testid="strategy-output-card"`).

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (Bold or Fill weight) to match the heavy Brutalist typography.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use standard Shadcn rounded cards. Override all border-radius to 0 (`rounded-none`).
Implement a strict Neo-Brutalist UI: 2px solid black borders and solid hard drop shadows (e.g., `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]`).
The application is a single screen. Do not build complex navigation.
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for the layout structure, inject Framer Motion for snappy interactions.
Ensure the generated strategy is instantly readable. The transition from Form to Strategy must be seamless, maybe pushing the form up or scrolling down automatically to the result.
All forms must have accessible labels. Use uppercase, wide-tracking styling for labels.
Do not use generic placeholder text. Use context-specific placeholders (e.g., 'e.g., 500-person theater' for room size).
